0022600016.text: The Celtics (3-1, with a three-game winning streak and a 3-0 home record) host the Bulls (1-4, on a three-game losing streak) in Boston's fifth game of the season, sitting 2nd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, and 3rd in the East. Chicago is 4th in the Central, 3 games back, 12th in the East, and 1-2 on the road, with Nic Claxton out (hamstring) and Jalen Smith (finger) and Tobe Awaka (ankle) day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Boston is without Devin Carter (out, illness). The Celtics lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 and won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 134-99 win in Boston on October 26.
